description: Complex proton form factors, including the tabulated lower/central/upper UA variants, and species-separated fragmentation coefficients for Fig. 7.
form_factor_interpolation: Linear interpolation of the real and imaginary parts, as in the source calculation. The archived table has 5 MeV knots; a finer evaluation grid does not add physical resolution to that input.
fragmentation_interpolation: Interpolate each nonresonant production coefficient in mass; evaluate the original analytic vector-meson mixing weights at the requested mass.
form_factor_band_prescription: Envelope of original authors lower/central/upper complex UA tables, with real and imaginary parts linearly interpolated. The SensCalc resampling is bypassed because its phase-wrap interpolation introduces sign flips near 0.945-0.965 GeV. Lambda_p is held fixed.
